verdict.rationale: The evidence shows AnythingLLM runs locally and keeps document knowledge on-device. Nothing in the pack documents a memory store the user can inspect, edit, or delete, or that such memory is kept in an open format. Local-only processing and a document knowledge base are adjacent features, not the memory-management capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As a privacy-first user, I can inspect, edit, and delete what the assistant has remembered — the memory store lives on my machine in an open format
